_doc: expect: must_pass | expected_fail. expected_fail records today's known cross-surface differences (reasons cite the U1 table in the Unification Plan, rulings 16/24/25) with the baseline metrics at the first run; the suite is green while each still fails within drift_band, red on XPASS (flip to must_pass: that is the gate) or DRIFT (the difference changed, so something else changed). Device-only fixtures (listening, boot) are guarded by baselines/ only.
